DECISION: Don't build session persistence or crash recovery
  OPTIONS: Persist sessions to disk + reload on restart vs current in-memory only
  REASONING: Workers come back alive as soon as a new prompt is sent — hooks re-register, session re-appears. The 'problem' of losing state on crash is self-healing. Not worth the infrastructure complexity.
  REVISIT WHEN: If workers gain meaningful per-session state that can't be recovered (e.g., task history users care about)
